text:
Estimated from the photos: the meal was two meat-filled cannelloni with cheese and tomato sauce, plus a bowl of mixed vegetables (carrot, broccoli, corn).

Cannelloni: two pieces at about 150 g each is roughly 300 g. At about 1.5 kcal/g (pasta, meat ragù, cheese) that comes to about 450 kcal.

Vegetables: about 120 g at about 0.5 kcal/g is roughly 60 kcal.

Total served: about 420 g and 510 kcal.

After eating, only sauce smears and a few crumbs remain on the plate, and a few green bits remain in the bowl. I estimated about 95% was eaten, which gives about 400 g and about 485 kcal.
